error.message: The loop through MIX13, MIX3, PUMP14, KREA4, SCDS5, HTXR6, MIX7, EXTR8, SPLIT9, HTXR19, HTXR10, HTXR18, SCDS15, SCDS11, SPLIT16, HTXR12, HTXR17 did not converge: at iteration 13, Column SCDS11: the rigorous column did not converge. Tried: Newton from the bubble-point start, steps of at most 20 K (12 iterations, 4576 ms: the residual fell only from 0.0001558 to 0.0001207 in 12 iterations); continuation in the relative volatilities (stopped at 99.32 % of the way, after 15 steps, 42115 ms); Newton resumed from where the bubble-point start stopped, without the early stop (100 iterations in all, 19333 ms: 88 iterations were not enough); continuation in the relative volatilities, the mean weighted by the liquid (stopped at 90.81 % of the way, after 19 steps, 108794 ms). Last residuals: material 0.00008001 mol/s, equilibrium 0.00003969, energy 32.09 W, specifications 1.808e-16. Two liquids are allowed on the stages (phases "VLL"); on the last iterate stages 1, 2 held two liquids. Newton converges slowly where a stage's liquid sits at the edge of the two-liquid region. This does not show that the column has no solution: try other specifications (a larger reflux, another product flow), more stages, or another feed stage. (on an accelerated guess, wegstein, 0.032 % of the tear flows beyond the last pass's result; the last pass changed the tears by 2.44e-3. Check the specifications and the start values of the loop first; direct substitution, which never extrapolates, shows whether the guess was the cause). In the last accepted pass the tear streams together gained 0.241 kmol/h of Ethanol (nearly steady for 11 accepted passes in a row), lost 0.422 kmol/h of Ethyl acetate (nearly steady for 11 accepted passes in a row): material that keeps accumulating or draining means the products and purges, as specified, do not take what the loop receives (a product given by its flow, a feed in excess of what reacts, a component with no way out); look at the specifications first. What usually helps: a purge or a smaller recycle fraction (a recycle with no way out keeps growing), a guess for the tear streams (S27, S7, S21, S15, S24) close to the answer, another tear stream, another convergence method, or more iterations.
